name: AMC Nordic
description: A cool, minimal Scandinavian style: pale grey-blue page, white regions with almost no shadow, slate text, a muted fjord-blue primary, soft 12px corners and a thin white header with a slate rule.
helpText: Light style built on Vita. The page is a pale grey-blue, regions are white with a hairline border and a barely visible shadow, text is slate, and the primary color is a muted fjord blue that passes WCAG AA with white text. The header is white with a thin slate rule instead of a colored bar, the current menu entry is a soft tinted pill, and column headings and labels are quieter. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
